title: Foley: node graphs for sound-design logic
summary: The Foley panel is a node-graph editor for sequencing and choice logic; it generates FRust source and can build a reusable pod.
alternateQueries: How do I build a pod?
How do I save a Foley setup?

blocks.text: Foley is an execution-style node editor, like a visual script. Drag a node from the palette onto the canvas (right-drag pans, the wheel zooms). A new graph starts with a hint to add an On Trigger node to generate a cue.

blocks.definition: Turns the graph into FRust source you can read in the panel; "Generated OK." or the errors are shown below.
Builds the graph as a reusable FRust pod in the current project through the project's Frate service. The pod's reflected nodes are added back to this palette.
Resolves a published Frate pod and adds its reflected nodes to the palette.
Save or load the graph as a named project asset.
